mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing light drizzle and 66 degrees near the Verona Area High School under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The city has announced that a section of Hwy M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 6 through October 9 for road improvements, with detours directed to Old PB and Verona Avenue. Additionally, early voting for the November 3 election is available at City Hall starting October 20.

There is plenty to do today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, you can look forward to Art Bar Happy Hour at ART House 360 and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co.
On September 21, officers identified and cited an individual for the retail theft of candy from a business in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor is Double Strawberry, and the store will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
